title: Dataset | Mindset = Explainable AI | Interpretable AI
reasoning: The paper's core theoretical framework relies on a 'Duality of Reason' that identifies 'Interpretable AI' (IAI) with 'Inward Reasoning,' which it defines as being governed by the 'law of the heart' and resulting in ethics, morals, and justice. It explicitly attempts to lay a foundation for Ethical AI (EAI) and Trustworthy AI (TAI) by distinguishing these moral/epistemological components from objective explanations.
